scoop_count — DRIVE scoop op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.scoop_count(volume: 'float', radius: 'float', packing: 'float', *, density: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import scoop; scoop.scoop_count(volume: 'float', radius: 'float', packing: 'float', *, density: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("scoop_count"))

Usage

Number of particles from the volume and the packing fraction, N = V ν / ((4/3) π r³) (if density is given, also the mass N m_p and the bulk density ν ρ_p).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

packing ν は 較正値(同じ粒・同じ測り方で、数の分かった 1 回から N v_p / V_img を取る): 側面の輪郭は粒の外側の包絡なので、ν は充填そのものより小さく出る(包絡の分の体積を含む)。Raises ValueError: 体積 < 0、半径 ≤ 0、ν が (0, 1] の外。
